# secure galvano ai

> Process data and AI for electroplating and anodizing shops (Galvanik- und Eloxalbetriebe) in Austria, Germany and Switzerland. Stefan Maier, master electroplater and materials physicist, finds the causes of recurring defects in the data a plating line already records, shows where automation pays off, and sets up AI so that process readings stay protected. AI models reviewed by TÜV AUSTRIA (Trusted AI). Fixed prices, net, B2B only.

## Offers (German site, English versions linked)

Prerequisite for the analyses: process readings are recorded in a database system (not in Excel spreadsheets). Where that is missing, help with choosing a partner and setting up the recording is available, billed by effort.

- [Standortanalyse / Site Assessment](https://secure-galvano-ai.com/leistungen.html#standortanalyse): Does the data hold up, and where is the money? Data traffic light per line, defect patterns with potential. EUR 1,500 per site. Afterwards, on request, support in implementing selected use cases, billed by effort.
- [Erstanalyse / Initial Data Check](https://secure-galvano-ai.com/leistungen.html#erstanalyse): Readings already recorded in a database — are they usable, what is missing? EUR 1,500 per data set.
- [Fehlerursachenanalyse mit Demo-Werkzeug / Root Cause Analysis with Demo Tool](https://secure-galvano-ai.com/leistungen.html#analyse-je-fehlerbild): After a positive Initial Data Check — causes of one recurring defect pattern, Ishikawa findings and a demo tool that can be developed further and rolled out into operations. EUR 5,000 per defect pattern.
- [Einführung in den Betrieb / Rollout into Operations](https://secure-galvano-ai.com/leistungen.html#einfuehrung): After the demo tool is approved for a trial run and the requirements are agreed — further development and integration on the customer's hardware, without cloud. Billed by effort.
- [Begleitung und Betreuung / Follow-up](https://secure-galvano-ai.com/leistungen.html#danach): Support until defects are fixed (fixed price per project), then upkeep per monitored line.

## Data handling

- [Where data is processed](https://secure-galvano-ai.com/#lokale-datenverarbeitung): Tools are built on a synthetic test plant; real readings are analyzed only on our own encrypted computers, no AI service sees them; the finished tool runs on the customer's infrastructure without internet.
- [Security and compliance](https://secure-galvano-ai.com/sicherheit.html): EU AI Act, NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act, GDPR, IEC 62443, TÜV Trusted AI.
